label: Guide me: People & access

params.name: lede
params.default: Groups are roles: one group per person, groups inherit and override, and every screen's rule in one place.
params.label: lede

params.name: steps

default.title: People & access
default.say: Who has an account in {product}, which group each person is in, and what every group may open.

default.title: One group per person
default.say: Pick a person's group here. Owner opens everything; any other group gives its screens, and its Ops & chips rights.

default.title: Add a person
default.say: Add someone and choose their group in the same step. Leave the password empty and they get an invitation by email.

default.title: Groups at a glance
default.say: The family tree of your groups: each one inherits its parent's screens. Faded means inactive.

default.title: Make a group
default.say: Make as many groups as you need. Choose its parent, its Ops & chips rights and its members.

default.title: Inherit and override
default.say: No rule follows the parent. Allow or Deny here overrides it for this group. The nearest rule always decides; a person's own rule is nearest of all.

default.title: The bottom bar
default.say: The Bottom bar row switches the floating bar per group. Deny on the row takes the whole bar away; Deny on Chip Chat, Voice typing or any other button takes only that one, and its server door closes too. No rule keeps it on.

default.title: Make inactive
default.say: An inactive group gives nothing: its members get its parent's screens until you make it active again.

default.title: Delete safely
default.say: Delete asks where the members go, so nobody is left without a group by accident.

default.title: Why can't they?
default.say: Check a person shows every screen they may open, and the rule that decided it.

params.label: steps: title, say, target (what to light up), open (what to press first)
